mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.participant_name AS name, r.phone, r.college_id, c.name AS college_name, r.created_at AS registered_at, cr.checked_at AS checked_in_at FROM registration r JOIN college c ON c.id = r.college_id LEFT JOIN checkin_record cr ON cr.registration_id = r.id WHERE r.activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId}
